content: अघोष {%a.%} [नास्ति घोषो यस्य यत्र वा] .²1 Hard-sounding. See below. .²2 Devoid of cow-herds. .{@-षः@} The hard sound of a consonant, hollowness of sound with which all hard consonants and the Visarga are pronounced (one of the 11 kinds of बाह्यप्रयत्न. See <ls>P. VIII. 2. 1.</ls>) or the consonants so pronounced (खयां यमाः खयः Zक-Vपौ विसर्गः शर एव च . एते श्वासानुप्रदाना अघोषाश्च विवृण्वते ..).
